title: Computer Programmer
_note: Tasks from eMASCO (emasco.mohr.gov.my/masco/2514), fetched 21 Oct 2026. Questions are ours; each cites the task it was built from.

questions.text: Tell us about a program you wrote from a specification or brief. How did you make sure the code matched what was asked?
questions.source: eMASCO 2514, task 1: Menulis dan menjaga code outline yang digariskan dalam panduan dan spesifikasi menurut standard akreditasi kualiti.

questions.text: How do you check that a program produces the right output before you call it done?
questions.source: eMASCO 2514, task 3: Menjalankan percubaan runs dan aplikasi perisian untuk mengesahkan ia akan menghasilkan maklumat yang dikehendaki.

questions.text: Describe a technical problem you got stuck on. How did you explain it to someone else and solve it?
questions.source: eMASCO 2514, task 5: Mengenal pasti dan membincangkan masalah teknikal, proses dan penyelesaian.
